name: fmcg-erp-readonly
description: Read-only query of the distributor S6 ERP: customers, SKUs, sales orders, shipments, inventory and receivables, without any write operation.

display.name: S6 ERP 只读查询
display.description_zh: 只读接入经销商的 S6 ERP，查询客户、商品、订单、出货、库存与应收数据；所有工具均为只读，不会修改任何单据。
display.description_en: Read-only access to the distributor's S6 ERP for customers, SKUs, orders, shipments, inventory and receivables. Every tool is read-only and never writes documents.
examples_zh: 查一下华东区上周的出货明细
这个月哪些客户的应收超过了账期
列出库存低于安全库存的 SKU
把某客户近 12 个月的订单拉出来
examples_en: Show last week's shipment lines for the East region
Which customers are past their receivable terms this month
Pull the last 12 months of orders for a customer
